item.text: Now I'll compute the total households by village and get the top ones.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "python3 << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd

# Read the Excel file
df = pd.read_excel('/work/mis_apr_sep_2025.xlsx')

# Group by Village and sum the No. of HH
village_totals = df.groupby('Village')['No. of HH'].sum().reset_index()
village_totals.columns = ['Village', 'Total Households Reached']

# Sort by total households (descending)
village_totals = village_totals.sort_values('Total Households Reached', ascending=False)

# Display the top villages
print(\"Total households by village (sorted descending):\")
print(village_totals.to_string(index=False))

print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*50)
print(\"TOP VILLAGES BY TOTAL HOUSEHOLDS REACHED:\")
print(\"=\"*50)
print(\"\\n1.\", village_totals.iloc[0]['Village'], \"-\", village_totals.iloc[0]['Total Households Reached'])
print(\"2.\", village_totals.iloc[1]['Village'], \"-\", village_totals.iloc[1]['Total Households Reached'])
print(\"3.\", village_totals.iloc[2]['Village'], \"-\", village_totals.iloc[2]['Total Households Reached'])
EOF"
